content.rationale: The module set is flat files under `src/` (M-layout), declared once here, so the crate root is the one place the tree is named. `src/lib.rs` names every module, holds the verb table — one row per verb, each row pointing at the verb's own handler, the single enumeration the dispatcher and the bare list read, so no module carries a second copy — and exposes the assembled entry: resolve the substrate's handles once (M-context-injection) and hand the table and the context to the envelope, returning its status. `src/main.rs` is the thin `fn main` that calls that entry, so the path a test drives is the path production runs. The committed `Cargo.lock` pins the resolved dependency set the manifest declares and names the package the same (M-name); it is generated here, where the crate's targets first exist. The package name M-name fixes makes the library target `deccy_cli`, the path `src/main.rs` calls. The entry resolves the substrate's handles before the envelope (M-context-injection), so resolution is total (S3-root-optional), so a root-less context is a state and the init verb runs on it; a genuinely failing resolution is handed back to the envelope as a refusal (M-resolution-failure), and the globals are not exempt from resolution (M-globals-context). An unreadable working directory is not fatal: `"."` stands in (M-cwd-fallback), so the read stays total and a genuine failure still surfaces as a refusal. `src/jj_init.rs` (M-jj-init) and `src/verb_init.rs` (M-init) join the module set, and the table gains the `init` row first — one row per verb, so adding init touches nothing else (D23). The map names every module the crate root declares — M-store-read (tmwyqnyz) and M-jj-read (osplmlvq) among them.
